rawContent: So...are they also going to pull the episode with Dustin Hoffman as Lisa's substitute teacher? Or were we expected to forget that he was named as part of #MeToo as well?

@Miss_h3llion I read about that yesterday, and I said if the SIMPSONS producers are really going to go that route, then they better pull Dustin Hoffman's episode as well, since he got named as part of #MeToo. But they won't.

Good. His abuse of power, and all that he did to help make #MeToo & #TimesUp necessary hashtags, is exactly why he should be gone from Warner Bros.

And yes, he did a horrible job in how he handled the DCEU, but that's not the most important thing about this, nor should it be.
